δύναμαι: to be able, capable, strong enough
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
πέρνημι: to export for sale, to sell
πλανάω: to make to wander, lead wandering about
συνίστημι: to set together, combine, associate, unite, band together
σύνοιδα: to share in knowledge, be cognisant of
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἀναπίμπλημι: to fill up; to contaminate, infect
ἀντιμεθίστημι: to move from one side to the other, to revolutionise
ἀπανίστημι: to make rise up and depart, send away
ἄγαμαι: to wonder, be astonished; be envious
ἐμπίμπρημι: to kindle, burn, set on fire
ἐξίστημι: to put out of its place, to change
ἐξανίστημι: to raise up: to make one rise
ἐπίκαθίστημι: set upon, establish besides, appoint as a successor
ἐφίστημι: to set on, over; set in charge of
ἔραμαι: to love, to be in love with
ὑφίστημι: to place under; mid. to submit, to promise
